name: Profilles tools filter
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. **Initial Request**: Added a free text filter for the tools section in the EditProfile component
2. **Filter Implementation**: Created `selectedToolTextFilter` data property to store search input value
3. **Search Logic**: Updated `filteredToolsList` computed property to filter tools by name and description matching the text input
4. **UI Components**: Added search input field with icon and clear button in the Tools tab
5. **Combined Functionality**: Text filter works alongside the existing tag filter for more granular tool discovery

messages.content: Add free text filter for the tools

I'll add a free text filter for the tools section. This will allow users to search tools by name and description. ## Changes Summary | Section | Change | |---------|--------| | Data | Added `selectedToolTextFilter` for free text search | | Computed | Added `filteredToolsList` update to include text filter logic | | Template | Added text input filter field in Tools tab | | Methods | Added `onToolTextFilterChange` method | ## Updated File ```vue src/components/EditProfile.vue ``` ## Key Changes ✅ **Text search field** - New input in Tools tab with search icon ✅ **Real-time filtering** - Searches both tool name and description ✅ **Combined filters** - Works together with existing tag filter ✅ **Clear button** - Shows when text filter is active ✅ **Updated message** - Generic "No tools found matching your filters" when both filters return nothing
